Moore brings you to the lab. The alien seems to be quiet behind a thick pane of glass. It doesn’t look scared.
Moore says that The Intelligence Agency will take care of the alien.
The army test conducted by the general results in a devastating failure.
Mr. Moore gives you a black box. Inside, there are sheets of paper, among which you recognize Miss Kumiyo’s notes.
Unfortunately, people do not appreciate the sense of humor, and a crowd of rebels attacks your residence.
The cake is exquisite. However, soon after you try it, you start feeling sick.
Miss Kumiyo takes you to the gardens. She looks nervous.
Miss Kumiyo moves away slowly. She says that for now, it’s better not to disclose this discovery.
Miss Kumiyo brings you to the presidential room and closes the door. She speaks softly and looks nervous.
Impatient, Miss Kumiyo activates the device, which emits a particular sound. It’s so powerful that you feel pain. But she doesn’t seem to even hear it. The sound stops after a few seconds.
You tell the First Lady about Kumiyo’s research, her notes, and your true identity.
The First Lady leaves the room in silence after she gives you a withering glance. She looked suspicious.
The First Lady takes a strange device from her pocket and points it towards you. You feel an unbearable pain in your chest.
The crazy man is escorted out of the building by security officers. You think you see him smile.
The crazy man is dragged out of the building by security officers. He keeps laughing loudly.
General Ramsey repeats that he has nothing to do with the disappearance of the notes and then he leaves the room.
Governor Armstrong repeats that he has nothing to do with the disappearance of the notes and then he leaves the room.
Governor Armstrong suddenly changes appearance. His face changes color, his eyes grow brighter, his neck tightens and stretches.
Slowly Governor Armstrong abandons his alien form to resume the human one. Then he leaves the room.
A computer is sitting on the desk. On the other side of the screen appears a man. His face is hidden under a mask.
The masked man nods, then the screen becomes black.
The entity that was talking to you vanishes. You wake up in the presidential room.
The entity that was talking to you vanishes. You awaken inside the presidential room.
You confess to Miss Kumiyo that you have feelings for her, and that even the First Lady must have noticed it.
Miss Kumiyo blushes shyly and lowers her eyes. She leaves the room without saying a word.
Thanks to the intervention of President Nakato, the southern country army is withdrawing and the war is ending with a peace treaty.
Miss Kumiyo apologizes for wasting your time and then she leaves the room. She looks sad.
Miss Kumiyo kindly thanks you and then she leaves the room. She looks particularly happy.
The tea is delicious, it has a slight aroma of cinnamon and honey.
The tea is delicious, it has a slight aroma of lemon and ginger.
The tea is delicious, it has a slight aroma of strawberry and mango.
The tea is delicious, it has a slight aroma of cinnamon and orange.
The tea is delicious, it has a slight aroma of apricot and honey.
Your army has been called back and, even if for only a short while, you can enjoy a temporary truce with the southern countries.
The light appears, the air returns. You wake up in the presidential room.
Without further delay, the ambassador runs to you and attacks you. You don’t have time to react.
Without further delay, the ambassador runs to you to attack you. Agent Scott breaks into the room just in time to block him.
The victim of the virus, the ambassador, is hospitalized in a specialized establishment. He’s waiting for a cure to be found.
Thanks to the treatments offered by the government and doctors, infected people are slowly brought back to normal. The virus is no longer a threat.
Hai già attivato questa funzione, un commodoriano ti apparirà quanto prima possibile durante il gioco
This will have a continual effect.
Your name was publicly denounced. You are dismissed of your command and die due to an unknown illness.
Your residence is besieged by rebels, and you are captured. You’re hung by the neck.
People in the country, including yourself, begin to undergo mutations because of the strong radiation. You die in agony.
People love you. They describe you as the best president the country ever had. Unfortunately, you die due to an unknown illness.
Your condition gets worse. Despite the medical intervention, you die few minutes later.
The whole world disappears as a dark curtain falls over your eyes.
Following a fierce revolt, you are captured and executed publicly. Your body hangs upside down.
The general has too much power. He uses his influence to guide the rebel army. You get locked up and die in jail.
The government falls into the enemy’s hands. You are captured and executed along with what remains of your army.
You are dismissed of your command and exiled to the contaminated lands with your closest staff.
The result of biological weapons testing is a terrible epidemic that spreads throughout the nation. You are among the first to die.
Your head is sold to enemy countries and the government passes into their politicians’ hands.
The number of infected people grows and it won’t take long for the virus to reach you as well. You lose your mind and die.
Fallout shelters are essential in the case of high radiation levels. They will protect part of the population.
Religion can do many things. Rebellions will be less likely as long as there is the threat of divine punishment.
Despite the reasons behind it, the slaughter done by the army is unacceptable. An insurrection is around the corner.
Money can’t buy happiness, but it certainly can help. Thanks to this emergency fund, you’ll be covered in case of bankruptcy.
Special Forces Foxhound is an elite black ops unit. Specialized in covert operations, it will ensure that the nation will be secure against inside threats.
Despite the rainy days, gossip continues to pique people’s curiosity. They will ignore real problems for a while.
Each choice has consequences. For some weird reason, your mind can now predict them.
Secret military bases are a great defense in the event of an enemy invasion, especially when the army is weak.
Space is gone, time is insane. You feel the air dry out your mouth.
Despite the safety procedures activated, the virus is slowly spreading through the world. No one is safe.
Arm the ships, raise the fighters. A war has begun, and your army will be put to the test.
The First Lady slowly leads mankind to destruction.
You fixed the rips in the space-time continuum and saved the world. Well done!
Time abandons your world. Everything freezes.
Arrgh, it seems something’s wrong. I am really sorry about that. If it’s stopping you from playing, can you please try to close and re-open the game?
Four-leaf clovers bring luck. Who knows, maybe you’ll meet someone interesting.

If you remove your progress, you won’t be able to restore it. Continue?
Are you ready to start your mission?
You will find yourself in the year 2075 any minute. As a result of countless wars, your world is confused and chaotic.
Your role is to lead one of the few surviving nations not yet affected by radiation or biological attacks.
Yes. Men have played with fire, and now they pay the price for it.
Just try to keep the balance between the four powers, and maybe you’ll survive.
Are you ready to start your mission?
Oh, so this time you remember. Good for you.
It’s not my fault. You and your companions have caused this. And now it seems that you are going to die over and over.
I’m glad you think this because it will be hard for you to get out of this infinite loop. I’ll be back in some years...
Good. You will find yourself in the year 2075 any minute. I guess you already know what to do.
I can’t help you. It’s up to you to get out of this infinite loop. I’ll be back in some years...
Is there something you’re not understanding?
Congratulations, you managed to reach one of the 3 possible endings in this game.
To get the chance to unlock all other endings, you’ll go back to the starting year: 2075.
Don’t worry, the goals unlocked during the game and the character gallery will be saved.
Thank you for playing and again, good luck!
I knew it! It’s written all over your face. You lost your memory once again.
Don’t lie to me! It’s written all over your face. You lost your memory once again.
I am time. Ironically, I’m in a hurry right now, but I can at least refresh your memory.
We are in my world. So, metaphorically speaking, you are my guest.
Okay, fine. Are you sure you can handle it without some advice?
This is not for me to say. The only thing I can do to help you, at the moment, is to try to refresh your memory.
No items, no constructions, no active effects.
Each choice has consequences. With this gift, your mind will be able to see them.
Mr. President, the country is finally clean again. But the Minister of Health is taking all the credit. She accuses you of hindering her!
Mr. President, radioactivity levels are through the roof. We are no longer able to guarantee people’s health.
Are you all right, Mr. President? Your appearance is...
Mr. President, discontent is spreading, and the population is turning against the government.
Freeze! This is a coup d’etat, Mr. President.
Neighboring countries are attacking us. Our army is no longer able to defend itself against the invaders!
Mr. President, banks hold absolute power. They are leading an uprising against you and the current government!
Mr. President, our state is poor and we are overwhelmed by debts with foreign countries.
Sir, the virus is spreading, and victims are everywhere. We are no longer able to guarantee anyone’s health.
We are developing a serum that can increase the productivity of dairy cows. Can we test it?
Our current armaments would be ineffective in open warfare. Do we have permission to build nuclear weapons?
A current law doesn’t let people sell their goods overseas without explicit permission. If we modify it, the economy could benefit.
The law remains as it is
Some agents in law enforcement are corrupt and unjust. I will name them, but it’s up to you to take action.
A powerful company drains its toxic waste into the rivers under the government’s eyes.
The army is weak, and the population is lazy. We should bring the draft back.
The estuaries of some great streams have turned into swamps. We should repair those areas.
I would like to start a new study on arms and wars. Can I count on your funding?
The streets of the suburbs are unsafe. We need to increase the number of patrols!
Workers in state factories refuse to work any longer. They want a raise.
People are unhappy, but migrants might be a good scapegoat. We should blame them for all the problems.
Citizens of one city claim that it’s infested by mutants. Probably just an excuse to pay fewer taxes.
The population is rich, and the government needs money. We need to raise taxes.
Some workers are in revolt! Groups of people are plundering various cities. Police are overwhelmed.
Some fanatics have pillaged a hospital. They claim that only God has the power to save men.
This year, winter is particularly frigid and harvests have been limited. We could ask for help from the western countries.
I don’t want to owe them
The economy is booming, wars seem to fade away. We should keep some money for rainy days.
A new pesticide is greatly improving crop yields. What should we do with the earnings?
Foreign countries steal our inventions and patents. We must stand up to them!
The country is getting bored. Bring some cheerful content: fireworks, parades, some party!
I think more young people could be interested in science if more funds were allocated to schools.
Have you seen Crazy Jeffry around? He ran into the lab and took all the computer keyboards.
Of course, your researchers are really nice women. What’s her name... Kumiyo. You could put in a good word for me.
Foreign countries to the east ask us for weapons. They are willing to pay us considerably.
Kittens are beautiful. Do you like kittens? In my opinion, yes. I can bring some kittens to cheer up this palace!
Damn that crazy man! He surged into the cathedral and stole all the candlesticks. I will pay for him to be punished!
I disagree with the Minister of Health. The pesticide used in this country is neither toxic nor dangerous, but necessary!
A private company has received permission to chop down 70 hectares of wood! How is that possible?
Plants are the mirror of health. We need more green areas in the country.
We could make the gardens more beautiful if we only import some new flowers from Western countries.
Damn, you can smell the smoke from the factory this far into the city. And it ruins the plants. They should shut it down!
I’ll see what I can do
Since I was a child I’ve always had a p-passion for chemistry, you know? I think I would feel comfortable in a lab.
Sir, the first lady needs to go into town, but there are no drivers available. I c-can drive her.
Cows on farms have begun to produce blood instead of milk. The news will soon end up in newspapers!
G-good day, Sir. Bring m-my greetings to the lady, too!
Honey, what’s that gardener’s name... Green or something. He always greets me when I see him. He is really kind.
Honey, is this your letter? It’s so sweet that I can hardly believe it. Thanks for the thought.
Thank you, honey! The flowers you sent to the office were really beautiful.
This house, this palace... I don’t think it’s properly secured for you. We need more surveillance cameras!
Do you know what I found in the pocket of a magistrate visiting here? Nail clippers. Yes, I know, it’s scary. We should enforce searches.
There is anarchy here, and there is no security in anarchy. Let’s start by imposing the use of a badge.
Sir, do you travel by car? Yes? Good. I believe we should put your drivers through a psychological examination. You never know.
For heaven’s sake, do you still ride in that box that they call a helicopter? It’s not safe. We need a new one.
Do you really think everyone here follows the rules? Wrong! Let’s start by monitoring their internet connections.
Radiation in some inhabited suburbs is increasing drastically. Should we intervene?
The elevators in this place are really insecure. Using them is like playing Russian roulette. We need to replace them.
Your presidential room is too far from the emergency exit. Let’s trade it with the general’s room.
Sir, I don’t want to alarm you, but I suspect a theft... have you noticed that an eraser is missing from your desk?
I have no experience in politics. But in middle school, I used to be class president. Do you think I have a chance against the general?
In my opinion, people think better on a full stomach. Let’s set up a buffet prior to all of your meetings. I could handle it.
The food we have here is no longer as good as it used to be. We should change the supplier even if it is more expensive.
Our wine collection is poorly stocked. We should expand it. The general has been asking for something new for a long time.
Have you seen the general? I think he stole the last bottle of Richebourg.
Your security officer is annoying like pineapples on a pizza. He confiscated all my knives.
Don’t let news of this get out
Foreign states to the east suffer a terrible epidemic, which is decimating the population. Survivors seek shelter.
Your wife continues to ask for caviar for dinner. I have already explained that we’re out of it.
That Jeffry is really nice. We played cards the other day, even though I suspect he cheated.
I d-disagree with the Minister of Health. The pesticide used in the country is neither toxic nor dangerous, but necessary!
A private company has received permission to chop down 70 hectares of wood! How is that p-possible?
Plants are the mirror of health. We need more green areas in the c-country.
We could make the gardens m-more beautiful if we only import some new flowers from Western countries.
I love c-carnival, you know? I have always liked dressing up and creating new costumes. Even my mother wouldn’t recognize me!
Damn, you can smell the s-smoke from the factory this far into the city. And it ruins the plants. They should shut it down!
I’ll see what I can do
It seems that some of our soldiers are involved in smuggling weapons with the mob. Should we intervene?
Intensive farming throughout the country is becoming unmanageable due to a plant disease.
According to an anonymous call, your life may be in danger. Should we intensify security?
It seems that the trafficking of genetically modified animals is practiced in the south of the country, despite this being illegal.
Food grown in contaminated areas is sold in some cities. It’s absolutely dangerous.
Some pharmaceutical companies ask for government approval to test their products on animals.
We would like to organize a memorial ceremony in honor of the soldiers who died because of conflicts with the eastern countries.
The Minister of Health is making pretty much every kind of preservative illegal. This is obviously madness.
The people are not satisfied with our recent military decisions. They talk about conspiracies, corruption, and imminent war.
It seems that some homeless people live in the ruins of a nuclear power station. Some are disfigured by radiation. People are afraid of them.
The southern army is too strong, we must join forces with the west nations and fire back.
We need better artillery to push the enemies back!
We don’t have time to worry about the environment. A war is a war. We must use the heavy weaponry.
The black market is hindering the commercial activities of the state. Should we intervene?
My country needs more labor, while yours needs money. We could come to an agreement.
Ants, ants, ants everywhere. Surely, it’s the gardener’s fault. I will have a word with him.
Don’t you think the gardener is acting a little strange lately? Something about him isn’t right.
Dr. Kumiyo often talks about you, you know? She’s grateful for all the support you give her.
I know of some spas in the north of the country that were closed during the war. Put them back on track, and the country will benefit.
I like Dr. Kumiyo. She seems like a good woman, and her research looks promising. Make sure to continue financing it!
That guy, that hacker, that K… he doesn’t look like a bad guy in the end. If I were you, I would trust him.
Do you know what I found on your bed sheets this morning? An oil stain. Funny, right? I wonder how it got there.
I think the general and the Minister of Health are more than just friends. I’ve seen them often together. If you only knew how well they get along.
The research department is not doing its job. They need to employ more resources for weapons!
Honey, have you seen the housekeeper? Damn, I can never find her when I need to. Sometimes it seems like she’s avoiding me.
We should encourage trade between our countries. I’m sure it will bring economic benefits in the long run.
Our country promotes eco-sustainable businesses through funding. You should do it yourself too, the environment will benefit.
A dangerous fugitive seems to have crossed the border, and now is hiding in your country. Can I use your men to find and arrest him?
My researchers invented a new material. If used in bulletproof vests it makes them more resistant. But the technology to produce it is very polluting.
Ahahah. Wubba lubba dub dub! Ahahah.
Lately we have registered unusual variations in the gravitational field. We don’t know what it is yet.
In some peripheral areas, packs of stray dogs are spreading terror among the inhabitants. We should take action.
We have an emergency. A fire broke out in the city park. It’s burning!
Sir, there has been an explosion in one of your laboratories! The whole building is going to collapse.
A large part of the population still lives in extreme poverty. We should intervene.
The water used in some areas of the country is unusable due to groundwater pollution. We have to do something.
There has been a prison break in the north of the country. The fugitives are dangerous. We absolutely have to take action.
Women of little faith infest the city streets late at night. It’s a scandal! The government should prevent this from happening!
Several hospitals in the smallest cities aren’t following the health and hygiene standards. We should intervene.
I don’t think white is a color suitable for our floors. White distracts, it blinds. We need to completely change it.
On the internet, you are mocked and disdained. Should we introduce sanctions?
Our technology is outdated and obsolete. We have to invest more in research!
A group of researchers is working on a project to rescue some of the suburbs affected by radiation, but they lack funds.
A bit of leisure helps people to reduce stress. Build some recreational centers.
Your current home is not safe. We should invest some money to ensure better security.
Western countries are bombed by the eastern ones. People are fleeing the war and seek shelter in our country.
The living conditions of breeding animals in some parts of the country are deplorable. We should intervene.
An encouraging speech of a leader can improve the morale of the country.
The happiness of people and readiness of the army often go hand in hand. But not always.
It seems that money can buy everything on this planet but happiness. Like money, not even my advice can give you everything.
Sometimes it is good to clean even what is not directly under our eyes.
Our military budget is not enough. We need to increase it.
With each uphill battle, there is a descent. With the right way of thinking, it can be that the descent seems to us longer than the ascent.
Part of the population can not even eat; they have no money. We have to decrease taxes, or soon there will be an uprising.
The population is dissatisfied, they demand more money for recreational activities.
Thefts become more frequent in southern cities. The victims are seeking compensation from the state.
A new addictive drug is being smuggled in and its use is spreading. We need to increase border control!
A violent earthquake has struck one of the cities.
The streets of the cities are not safe. We should impose a curfew.
An old containment building seems to be falling apart. Radioactive materials inside it may be soon exposed.
It can still hold a little
I think the general does not like me. Every time he comes into the lab, he shouts at me.
A foreign country possesses scientific knowledge superior to ours, because its government permits human experimentation.
In poor areas, organized crime is king. The government should intervene.
The poorest areas in the country are also the most contaminated. We must act, people’s health is at stake.
Many of the laws governing the country are irrational and unjust. I am bringing this list to your attention.
Things are fine just as they are
The government should be more transparent with the people about its military policies.
The population needs money. I strongly recommend to make some donations to the poorest people.
I know you’re getting unusual messages on your personal phone, Mr. President. Be careful.
Part of the internet is constantly censored by the government. It’s something that should end.
Sir, good news! A large oil field has been found!
Western countries are attacking us. We have to return fire!
Our debt with foreign countries is growing. We could print more money to mend the situation.
Western foreign countries are investing in armaments. We must attack them before they attack us!
A very promising research group requires funding for a plant experiment.
Next week is your birthday. Why not organize a celebration?
Last night I dreamed of getting kidnapped. Can I have a bodyguard?
Next month there is an opening of a great art exhibition. We could join.
Current laws are old and unpopular. We need to update them.
We need a law that protects banks and financial institutions more.
Western countries offer us a peace treaty. It would be a good way to end the war.
People in the country have sacrilegious and blasphemous behavior. We should restore order with tougher methods.
I was thinking of introducing new commandments to our religion. I could meet your needs.
A pagan crowd is throwing stones at one of our cathedrals.
The army is weak and the number of our soldiers is dwindling. We should promote the recruitment of young people.
This modern tech wizardry such as robots and artificial intelligence are a clear sign that we are going against God!
Papa Laetonius’s doctrine is really taking off in the country. It’s dangerous, give him less power.
A group of religious fanatics targeted some of our research centers. Can the army take action?
The Nordic countries are without religion, we can arrange shipments and try to convert them.
My doctrine needs some funds. In return, I can persuade my believers to contribute to the cleanliness of this country.
One of your soldiers spit on the door of our cathedral while caught on camera. He must be punished!
I would like to introduce a new holiday to warm people’s hearts. Do I have your approval?
I know you’re married. I would like to celebrate your wedding in a cathedral so that it can also be a true love in front of God.
Your researchers are conducting profane experiments trying to change plants created by God. Stop it now!
We should sign an armistice with the western countries to stop wars. Their people follow our own religion.
Are we allowed to use nuclear power for our experiments? Research would benefit a lot.
Papa Laetonius forces his faithful to make long pilgrimages in areas still exposed to high radiation. We must intervene.
There are some cults in the country that are opposed to my doctrine. They are sacrilegious and dangerous!
A cult converts young people on the internet and manipulates them, leading to violent actions. People are upset.
There’s a new video in which a girl commits suicide in the name of religion. It’s terrible. It would be wise to try to censor it.
One thing pulls another. But somehow a lever does not pull itself. Build more hospitals!
Have you ever noticed that it is cold in winter? Yeah. Some buildings to accommodate poor people would be useful.
I have an idea, I have an idea! Hahaha. Why don’t we make gambling lawful again? It was fun, wasn’t it?
Even those who fight need to have fun. I propose to give more help to the young people of our army!
Have you seen? Didn’t you see it? There is a poor country out there that is rife with diseases! I should know, I have a couple of those too.
Some hooligans make fun of people like me, you know? And the police do nothing. Hey, I smell corruption here!
We should build embassies in neighboring countries. It would be useful to prevent wars.
Crazy Jeffry is disturbing the peace in this palace. He sings and dances, he says meaningless things.
I think Crazy Jeffry is embezzling in some smuggling business. I could get some information by force.
The world. This world, Mr. President. This world is wrong. I know it should not be so.
It will be, Mr. President. Yes, I know it will happen. You will find them, you will find those documents. They’re close, yes.
My head, my head hurts me. Something has changed, yes. Someone has traveled. Someone in here.
Mr. President, I was wondering: do you sweat or lose oil? Hahaha.
He will help you, though. Certainly. You do not have to worry about what you do not know. I know, yes. He will make things right.
He will help you, though. Certainly. You do not have to worry about what you do not know. I know, yes. He will make things right.
A serious plague has broken out in one of our cities. Doctors say it could be contagious.
The northeastern states are in trouble because of the winter. They ask for economic support.
The ongoing war against the eastern countries has brought us some prisoners.
Banks offer us financial support in exchange for greater protection from the army.
Some power plants would like to get rid of waste in an... uncomfortable way. But they would be willing to pay.
A group of food researchers would like to do experiments on grain so that they make crops more resistant.
A criminal organization is slowly taking possession in peripheral areas of some cities.
We have found that some charitable organizations are just a front for the trafficking of illicit substances.
Soldiers in some parts of the country are very numerous. They spend their time lazing about. We could cut funds and reduce their numbers.
A strong tornado has struck one of our cities. It destroyed an old nuclear power plant. Slag is spreading.
A study on peanuts was closed due to lack of results. Many of the products that were to be used in the tests are left over.
Distribute the leftovers to the population
The country needs more powerful energy sources. Can we reopen nuclear power plants?
Surviving is never a bad thing. With this, you can escape from a premature death.
Hello. I see that you have an extra heart with you. You can continue to live if you wish.
Failed to sign in. Please check your network connection and try again.
There was an issue with sign-in, please try again later.
Your phone displays strange symbols followed by a message: 2082, 2119, 2150
I’m sorry, but this time I have nothing left for you.
You can tap on the top panel to access the game settings. Did you know that?
You can click on the bottom panel to access the effects menu. Did you know that?
The more you go through the years, the more cards will be added to the game deck. I wonder what happens in 2150.
Hi, I’m Nabil, the creator of this game. Can I ask you if you’re enjoying it?
I’m sorry, I did my best to create it. Let me help you with some resources.
I’m glad you like it, really. Would you like to leave a positive review?
Thank you, you’ve been very kind. Let me help you with some resources.
Hi, I’m Nabil, the creator of this game. I want to let you know that some advertisements will be appearing from this moment on.
I know the ads are boring, but they help me to cover some expenses and allow me to improve my work.
If you do not want the ads, you can buy me a coffee for a few cents and the ads will disappear forever.
Thank you for being generous. Now enjoy the entire game without advertising!
Mr. President! Mr. President! Are you all right? You look pale. I think we should call a doctor.
That’s enough. Now I’m really tired.
I give you one thing to do, and then you and the other one continually violate my domain.
That’s not a game. The time-space continuum should not be touched in any way.
The consequences could be really, really unpleasant.
I am making an ultimatum. You have time until 2150 to make things right. I advise you - don’t disappoint me again.
Then prove it, tell me something that only The Traveler would know.
You did it again, didn’t you?
I’m talking about traveling over time. My species can perceive when the time-space continuum is altered.
And so you are The Traveler. Or at least one of the two.
I can’t help you, but Kenny probably can.
Kenny is the name of the soiled alien in our lab, the one you call Subject 13.
Just tell him this: Red Roswell. He will understand.
This place is a bit boring. You could let me go if you still don’t know who I am looking for.
Sorry, what? I don’t understand you. You are odd today, Mr. President.
But... how do you know? It is not my fault that night I dropped the ketchup on the spaceship controls!
I see it, I see it. I can tell you what I know about this story.
I’ll only talk to The Traveler. You can torture me, but I will not say anything else.
Everything started in June 2020. In that year, something showed up, altering the normal timeline.
The world at this time has become the dystopian reality we know today.
I think this is due to the construction of a time machine in the future of the original timeline.
You come from another era too. It’s obvious. However, the person who created this reality is not you.
In fact, I believe that you have been sent here to remedy the errors of that person.
